title: COVID red-status staff scheduling - January 2021
summary: A restricted January 2021 staff schedule documents an emergency rotation used while Rockcastle County was in COVID 'red' status. X marks represented a day off or work-from-home day for roles able to work remotely, while dispatch/garage and CSR operations followed separate continuity arrangements.

claims.claim: A schedule revised January 13, 2021 states that an X marks a day off or work-from-home day for those able to work remotely while Rockcastle County remained 'red' with COVID.

evidence.note: Employee names and individual schedules are excluded.

claims.claim: The schedule assigns individualized weekly X-day patterns and notes that some assigned days were subject to change.

The schedule states that Dispatch and Garage would continue as usual and that CSRs would operate under a separate existing schedule, showing role-specific continuity rules rather than one universal remote-work rotation.

trigger: Emergency public-health status required reduced/rotating on-site staffing.
prerequisites: Identify functions that can work remotely without disrupting essential operations.
Maintain coverage for operations requiring in-person or separately scheduled staffing.
steps: Determine emergency status/need for reduced on-site staffing.
Assign individualized days off or work-from-home days to eligible roles.
Keep essential/role-specific operations on their separate continuity schedules.
Revise individual days as operational needs change.
decisions: When individual rotation days must change.
exceptions: Dispatch/Garage and CSR operations followed different continuity arrangements in the supplied 2021 schedule.
controls: Historical emergency arrangement only; do not treat as current remote-work entitlement or policy.
unresolved_questions: What formal COVID/emergency continuity policy governed this schedule, if any?
Does RTEC currently have an emergency remote-work/business-continuity plan and role eligibility rules?
What event/status formally ended the red-status rotation?
automation_candidates: Emergency staffing planner that marks essential on-site functions, remote-capable roles, coverage requirements and revision history.
Publish employee-specific schedules through restricted views while retaining only aggregate continuity rules in the knowledge base.

provenance.notes: Names and individual day assignments excluded.
